tools.name: agent_input_firewall
tools.description: Scan untrusted input: injection risk + PII redaction + sanitized text + allow/review/block verdict

tools.name: agent_output_validator
tools.description: Validate LLM output: repair JSON, enforce schema, check grounding against a source, extract citations

tools.name: pii_redactor
tools.description: Redact emails, phones, SSNs, cards (Luhn), IPs, API keys and JWTs

tools.name: token_compressor
tools.description: Compress text to a target ratio of its original length

tools.name: json_auto_repair
tools.description: Repair malformed JSON from LLM output

tools.name: schema_enforcer
tools.description: Validate and coerce data to a JSON Schema

tools.name: hallucination_diff
tools.description: Flag answer sentences unsupported by the source text

tools.name: citation_extractor
tools.description: Extract URLs, DOIs, arXiv ids and author-year citations

tools.name: context_chunker
tools.description: Split text into token-bounded overlapping chunks
